mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an active monetary easing cycle that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production by more than 2% and a rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the same month signals a severe economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls >2% and UNRATE rises >0.5% in the same month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months), the increased cost of capital reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts by more than 5% and a rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in the same month signals a housing market collapse and labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls >5% and UNRATE rises >0.3% in the same month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level below 800.0 (thousands of units) indicates a severe housing market contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 800.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
